body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: up to 6 Cursor specialists in parallel (plan-fidelity when plan available) + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1: 5 reviewers OK (correctness, testing, edge-cases, plan-fidelity, codex-generic); 2 NOT_SUBSTANTIVE (structure, security).

Accepted: 4 critical fixes (git-show-stage, sessionstart-health, gh-pr-checks, pre-commit-shellcheck).
Rejected: commit grouping (style), branch scope (pre-existing), false-positive-keywords (correctly excluded as sourced-only).
